title: Move the stable persona prefix into the system prompt via --append-system-prompt-file
source: Verified locally against installed CLI 2.1.267 `claude --help`: `--append-system-prompt-file` and `--exclude-dynamic-system-prompt-sections` ("Move per-machine sections (cwd, env info, memory paths, git status) from the system prompt into the first user message. Improves cross-user prompt-cache reuse") — plus https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/effective-context-engineering-for-ai-agents on system-prompt structuring
description: build_prompt's own docstring (delegate.py:1679) says 'The `claude -p` CLI path has no cache_control hook, so consistent prefix ordering is the only lever available here.' That is no longer true: the installed CLI exposes `--append-system-prompt-file` (put the role persona where a system prompt belongs, ahead of the user turn) and `--exclude-dynamic-system-prompt-sections` (evict cwd / env info / memory paths / git status — which change every run and currently sit in front of everything, poisoning the cache prefix). Today the whole ~4KB stable prefix is re-sent as part of the user message on every delegation, behind per-machine sections that shift between runs, so the cache prefix breaks on content the orchestrator never intended to vary.
proposed_changes: 1) Split build_prompt into `build_system_prefix(root, agent_role)` (role prompt, available_tools, effort guidance table, reasoning_protocol, self_critique, execution_rules, common_mistakes, output_format) and `build_task_prompt(...)` (everything currently in the volatile suffix). Keep build_prompt as a thin wrapper that concatenates both, so every existing caller and test keeps working. 2) Write the system prefix to `.cto/cache/system-{agent_role}-{sha1[:8]}.md` (content-addressed so a persona edit produces a new file rather than a stale hit) and pass `--append-system-prompt-file <path>` on the worker cmd (~line 2458-2515), sending only the task prompt as the `-p` argument. 3) Add `--exclude-dynamic-system-prompt-sections` to the same cmd. 4) Gate both behind a `cache_optimized_prompt.enabled` key in .cto/config.json (default off) plus support probes modelled on `_check_claude_effort_support()` — same staged-rollout pattern as `native_subagents.enabled`. 5) Honour the documented resume caveat: `--append-system-prompt` is recorded on first launch and replayed verbatim by `--resume`, so skip both flags on the `claude --resume <session_id>` branch and never assume a mid-ticket persona edit takes effect. 6) Order the prefix per the 2026 system-prompt structure already half-followed here: identity/specialization → rules/conventions → protocols → output contract → anti-patterns (`common_mistakes`) LAST, which means moving the common_mistakes block after output_format.
last_error: Evolve timed out after 300s (flat default, pre-fix)
